The tailgate step with lift assist, combined with LED box lighting and power-sliding rear window, makes truck bed access and use more practical. Memory settings for seat, pedals, and exterior mirrors recall your preferred positions automatically.

This F-150 Raptor presents a compelling choice for buyers seeking a well-equipped, capable truck with luxury appointments. The Raptor's reputation for durability combined with these premium features and accessories makes this an attractive opportunity. description: 2014 Ford Mustang GT Premium Convertible For Sale This 2014 Ford Mustang GT Premium Convertible is a one-owner car with 16,911 original miles, pairing an unusually well-preserved history with a serious supercharged build. The seller purchased it new from Champion Ford in Erie, Pennsylvania in August 2014 and stored it every winter. Finished in Black over a Charcoal Black leather interior with a black cloth power top, it carries the full GT Premium equipment list along with the factory Brembo Brake Package. 2014 was the final model year of the S197 Mustang before the redesigned S550 arrived for 2015, which makes a low-mileage, single-owner example like this one a notable send-off for the generation. Power comes from the 5.0L 4-valve Ti-VCT "Coyote" V8 backed by the MT82 6-speed manual, now built well beyond stock. The car runs a Roush supercharger with a Roush cold air intake, Cook's long-tube headers with high-flow catalytic converters, and a Shelby axle-back exhaust, all brought together with a custom Brenspeed tune. According to Brenspeed, who installed the supercharger and wrote the tune, the combination is good for roughly 700 horsepower and 599 lb-ft of torque. A one-piece carbon fiber driveshaft handles the added power, and a boost gauge mounted on the dash to the left of the wheel lets the driver keep an eye on the blower. The supporting hardware follows the same theme. Shifts go through a Steeda Tri-Ax shifter with a custom handle, while a Steeda strut tower brace and BMR adjustable suspension, including a rear panhard bar, tighten up the chassis. Braking is handled by that factory Brembo setup, and the car sits on staggered 20-inch SVE wheels from Late Model Restoration, running 8-inch-wide fronts and 10-inch-wide rears. Inside, the GT Premium cabin includes leather sport seats, a power driver's seat, the Shaker audio system, SYNC, and ambient lighting, and the factory GT Convertible Accessory Package adds the pedestal rear spoiler and side scoops. The result is a Mustang the seller describes as docile enough to run for groceries but with plenty of power on tap when it is wanted. For a buyer who wants a genuinely quick, well-sorted supercharged Coyote convertible without the wear of a typical modified car, this low-mileage, one-owner example covers both sides. - Cummins 6.7L I6 Turbodiesel engine with heavy-duty performance
- 4WD with 4.10 axle ratio and dual rear wheels
- Limited Level 1 Equipment Group with premium technologies
- Night Edition styling with black exterior accents and sport performance hood
- 12 Uconnect 5 Navigation touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Surround View Camera System with Trailer Reverse Guidance
- 17-speaker harman/kardon premium sound system
- Auto Level Rear Air Suspension for a smooth, controlled ride
- Power Deployable Running Boards and LED Bed Lighting
- MOPAR Spray In Bedliner for lasting cargo protection
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus
- Heated and ventilated leather front seats with memory functions
- Power sunroof for an open-air driving experience
- Trailer towing prep packages designed for serious hauling

The Cummins diesel engine combines proven reliability with the latest engine management technology. Heavy-duty engine cooling and supplemental heating ensure consistent performance in any condition. The truck carries dual alternators rated at 440 amps and dual 730-amp batteries, providing the electrical capacity required for work-site equipment and towing applications.

Inside, the Limited cabin welcomes you with genuine wood accents on the dash, doors, and console. Heated leather steering wheel, power driver seat with memory, and automatic climate control create a professional environment for long days on the road. The 12 touchscreen integrates navigation, connectivity services, and vehicle information seamlessly.

Active safety systems complement the trucks capable chassis. Adaptive steering, lane keep assist, and electronic stability control work together to enhance handling and stability. The auto-dimming rearview mirror and ParkView backup camera add confidence during maneuvering and backing operations.

The Night Edition package distinguishes this truck with blacked-out styling¬??black grille, black headlamp bezels, black tail lamp bezels, and a sport performance hood. Combined with the satin carbon 20-inch wheels and chrome accents, this 3500 Limited presents a commanding appearance.

This truck represents the full capability and luxury available in a modern heavy-duty diesel. Every feature listed has been selected to support both professional use and daily driving comfort. We invite you to visit our showroom to see this exceptional vehicle in person.

description:
2016 Ford F-250 Super Duty Lariat Crew Cab 4x4 with only 42,657 miles, finished in Ruby Red Metallic Tinted Clearcoat with a Black premium leather interior. This exceptionally low-mileage Super Duty combines proven Power Stroke diesel performance, heavy-duty four-wheel-drive capability, spacious Crew Cab accommodations, and upscale Lariat comfort in a truck built for demanding work and long-distance travel.

Power comes from Ford s 6.7L Power Stroke V8 Turbo Diesel B20 engine paired with a TorqShift 6-speed automatic transmission with overdrive. This renowned diesel powertrain delivers substantial low-end torque, confident highway acceleration, and the pulling strength expected from an F-250. The transmission includes driver-selectable operation and an integrated oil cooler to support heavy-duty use.

Part-time four-wheel drive allows the driver to engage additional traction when road, jobsite, or surface conditions require it. The 3.31 rear axle ratio provides a useful balance of highway operation and diesel capability, while the 10,000-pound GVWR Payload Package reinforces this truck s heavy-duty foundation.

The suspension uses a solid front axle with coil springs and a solid rear axle with leaf springs. Heavy-duty gas-pressurized shock absorbers, a front stabilizer bar, hydraulic power-assisted steering, and four-wheel vented disc brakes help provide the control and durability expected from a Super Duty. ABS, Brake Assist, and Hill Hold Control provide additional support during braking and operation on grades.

An extra-heavy-duty 200-amp alternator and dual 78-amp-hour, 750-CCA batteries provide the electrical capacity and starting power needed for diesel operation and compatible accessories. A factory trailer wiring harness supports towing-related electrical connections, while the transmission oil cooler helps manage heat during demanding use.

Ruby Red Metallic Tinted Clearcoat gives this F-250 an upscale and distinctive appearance that complements the premium Lariat trim. Exterior highlights include 18-inch bright machined cast-aluminum wheels, LT275/65R18E all-season tires, a full-size spare, variable intermittent windshield wipers, cargo lighting, and a traditional Super Duty stance.

The Crew Cab configuration provides four full-size doors and generous space for both front and rear passengers. The Black premium leather 40/console/40 front seating layout includes a substantial center console for storage and organization, making the cabin suitable for work, family use, or extended highway trips.

The rear FlexFold 60/40 split bench can fold and flip forward, creating additional protected interior storage when passengers are not occupying the second row. This provides a secure place for tools, luggage, electronics, work equipment, or other belongings that should remain inside the cab.

Lariat interior appointments give the cabin a more refined atmosphere than a basic work truck. Convenience features include a tilt-and-telescoping steering column, Driver Information Center, outside-temperature display, front and rear map lights, multiple storage areas, cupholders, illuminated interior lighting, and cargo-box lighting.

Technology includes SYNC with MyFord Touch and SYNC Services, providing voice-operated access to compatible phone, communication, entertainment, and vehicle functions. Introducing this 2025 GMC Yukon XL AT4 Ultimate in Silver, a full-size luxury SUV engineered for those who demand capability and refinement in every journey.

- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD with Active Response and Magnetic Ride Control Suspension
- Super Cruise hands-free driving technology
- 16.8 premium GMC infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Bose 18-speaker surround sound with SiriusXM 360L
- Full grain leather heated and ventilated seats with massage functions
- Dual-pane panoramic power sunroof
- Heads-up display with 15 diagonal multi-color screen
- OnStar services and advanced security package
- Max trailering package with integrated trailer brake controller and smart trailer integration

This Yukon XL AT4 Ultimate combines genuine off-road capability with premium comfort. The EcoTec3 6.2L V8 delivers power when you need it, while the advanced Magnetic Ride Control Suspension with adaptive air springs adjusts to road conditions in real time. The Active Response 4WD system manages traction intelligently, making this vehicle competent whether you're navigating city streets or tackling challenging terrain.

Inside, the cabin showcases full grain leather throughout, with heated and ventilated driver and front passenger seats that include power massage functions. A wide range of power adjustments ensures every driver finds their ideal position. The massive 16.8 infotainment display provides intuitive control, while wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps your digital life seamlessly connected.

Entertainment and convenience abound with the Bose 18-speaker system, rear seat media system featuring an 8 touchscreen, and SiriusXM 360L satellite radio. The dual-pane panoramic sunroof floods the interior with natural light. For leaders in technology, Super Cruise hands-free driving and the 15 heads-up display represent the pinnacle of modern driving assistance.

Trailering capability is exceptional, supported by the integrated trailer brake controller, smart trailer integration indicator, and hitch view camera. Recovery hooks and an extra capacity cooling system stand ready for serious towing demands. Inside, you'll find thoughtful details like heated and power-retractable assist steps, a garage door transmitter, and comprehensive climate control including rear air conditioning and heated rear seats.

The AT4 Ultimate trim reflects GMC's commitment to luxury, featuring premium exterior touches including a black roof luggage rack, 20 machined and painted alloy wheels, and black GMC emblems. Power-retractable assist steps make entry effortless, while the power-operated liftgate with hands-free operation adds genuine convenience to daily use.

This 2025 GMC Yukon XL AT4 Ultimate represents a substantial investment in quality, performance, and refinement. We welcome you to visit our showroom to experience this capable luxury SUV firsthand and discuss how it can meet your specific needs.

The GVWR payload package supports substantial loads, while dual heavy-duty alternators ensure consistent electrical power for any auxiliary equipment.

The Clean CarFax history and well-maintained condition of this F-350SD demonstrate its reliability. Safety is paramount in this XC40. The comprehensive airbag system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction management work together to protect you and your passengers. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and occupant sensing technology demonstrate Volvo's commitment to thorough protection.

Inside, you'll find HomeLink garage door transmitter capability, a trip computer, and memory seating that remembers your preferences. The power-adjustable driver and passenger seats paired with the split-folding rear seats adapt to your lifestyle, whether carrying passengers or cargo.

Schedule your visit today to experience this 2022 Volvo XC40 R-Design firsthand. Our team is prepared to answer your questions and arrange a test drive at your convenience.
